why: Image 2 has the better-balanced view into the lit timber alcove, with the artwork on the left and the chair on the right framing the pair, and nothing in it gives the render away as badly as the smeared, mannequin-like figure on the right edge of Image 1. Image 2 still has problems: its foreground side table is blocky and its lamp globes are blown out. But Image 1 also has the odd card leaning on the right plinth and a large empty patch of carpet, which makes it look more like CG.
